import json, os, stat, platform, time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/afs-managed-control-capacity-20261007-r1')
rootfs=root/'rootfs'
control=root/'control'
def meta(p):
    try:
        st=os.lstat(p)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {'path':str(p),'exists':False}
    m=st.st_mode
    if stat.S_ISREG(m): typ='regular'
    elif stat.S_ISDIR(m): typ='directory'
    elif stat.S_ISLNK(m): typ='symlink'
    elif stat.S_ISCHR(m): typ='char_device'
    elif stat.S_ISBLK(m): typ='block_device'
    elif stat.S_ISFIFO(m): typ='fifo'
    elif stat.S_ISSOCK(m): typ='socket'
    else: typ='other'
    d={'path':str(p),'exists':True,'type':typ,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(m)),'uid':st.st_uid,'gid':st.st_gid,'dev':st.st_dev,'ino':st.st_ino,'size':st.st_size}
    if typ=='symlink': d['target']=os.readlink(p)
    if typ in ('char_device','block_device'):
        d['rdev']=st.st_rdev; d['major']=os.major(st.st_rdev); d['minor']=os.minor(st.st_rdev)
    return d
entries=[]; violations=[]

            m=meta(p); entries.append(m)
            if m.get('type') not in ('regular','directory'):
